value.answer: Tomorrow in Toronto looks showery and warm, high of 24°C. Showers end around noon, but there's a 60% chance of them plus a risk of thunderstorms through the morning and afternoon, with southwest wind 20 km/h gusting to 40 near noon. Tuesday night drops to a low of 12°C with a 60% chance of showers. Wednesday is cooler, high 19°C, 30% chance of showers. That's the Environment Canada forecast from 11 am today.
